questions: If there are fewer than 30 unique strings generated, should the histogram show fewer than 30 bars (all strings) or still show 30 bars with zero frequencies for missing strings?
Should the histogram bars be sorted by frequency (descending) or by string lexicographically?
Is the random generation with replacement (strings can repeat) or without replacement per row?
Should the function set a random seed internally, or rely on external seeding?
What should happen if multiple strings tie for the 30th most frequent? Should we include all ties (more than 30 bars) or break ties arbitrarily?
Are the strings case-sensitive? Must they be strictly lowercase?
Should the histogram include gridlines, specific colors, or other styling beyond the title and axis labels?
Is the function expected to close or show the plot, or just return the Axes object?
